home.title: Trash Separator
home.subtitle: Take or upload a photo to classify the waste item.
home.takePhotoHint: Opens the camera to photograph a waste item
home.choosePhotoHint: Picks an existing photo from your library
home.barcodeHint: Best for packaged goods with barcodes
home.voiceModeHint: Hands-free commands for the whole app
home.voiceModeA11yHint: Starts hands-free voice commands for taking photos, history, impact, and questions
home.guidedModeHint: Spoken help to aim the camera, hands free
home.guidedModeA11yHint: Opens the camera and speaks directions to help you aim, then captures and reads the result aloud
home.impactHint: Shows what your classifications have saved so far
home.impactEmpty: Classify an item to start tracking
home.askAiHint: Opens a chat to ask follow-up questions
home.dropoffHint: Shows recycling centers near you that take this material
home.clearHistoryHint: Deletes all saved classifications and chats
home.openChatHint: Opens a chat about this item

result.putInRecycling: Put it in the recycling bin.
result.putInTrash: Put it in the regular trash.

chat.title: Ask AI
chat.clearConfirm: This deletes the conversation for this item.
chat.disclaimer: AI responses may be inaccurate. Verify with your local recycling authority.
chat.suggestionDispose: How should I dispose of this?
chat.keyMissing: Add EXPO_PUBLIC_OPENAI_API_KEY to a .env file and restart the dev server to enable the assistant.
chat.placeholderNoKey: Add an API key to chat

settings.title: Settings
settings.languageHint: Used for the whole app, speech, and the chatbot.
settings.themeHint: Used across result cards, charts and camera guides.
settings.voiceOutputHint: Guided Mode and Voice Mode always speak, whatever this is set to.
settings.hapticFeedbackHint: Short taps when Voice Mode hears a command.
settings.reduceMotionHint: Cuts camera animations and number count-ups.
settings.simpleLanguageHint: Shorter words in the chatbot, suited to about age 8.
settings.testVoiceSample: This item is recyclable. Rinse it and place it in the recycling bin.
settings.autoListenHint: Starts Voice Mode as soon as the app launches.
settings.unitsAuto: Automatic (miles in US English, km elsewhere)
settings.voiceDebugHint: Shows the state machine, transcript and last intent.
settings.footnote: Text size, VoiceOver and Reduce Motion follow your device settings.

theme.standardHint: Green for recyclable, amber for trash.
theme.colorBlindHint: Blue for recyclable, orange for trash.

impact.title: Your Impact
impact.streakHint: Consecutive days with at least one classification
impact.emptyTitle: Take your first photo to start tracking your impact
impact.emptyBody: Every item you classify adds to your recycling totals, your streak, and your estimated CO₂ and water savings.
impact.shareUnavailable: This device cannot open the share sheet.
impact.shareFailed: Something went wrong while building your impact summary. Please try again.
impact.footnote: Savings are estimates based on average per-item coefficients, not measurements of your specific items.

nearby.title: Drop-off nearby
nearby.noCentersMaterial: No centers within {{radius}} for this material. Try another ZIP.
nearby.mapNeedOrigin: Allow location or enter a ZIP to see the map
nearby.disclaimer: Center data is for demonstration. Always call ahead to confirm.
nearby.locationFailed: Could not read your location. Enter a ZIP code instead.
nearby.rationaleBody: Location is used only to list recycling drop-off sites within {{radius}}. It is not stored or sent anywhere except this device.
nearby.websiteHint: Opens this center's website in the browser
nearby.directionsHint: Opens Maps with this center as the destination
nearby.centerHint: Opens hours, phone number, and directions
nearby.zipHint: Used when location access is off

permissions.cameraReason: We need camera access to photograph items for classification.
permissions.locationReason: We use your location to find nearby recycling centers.
permissions.microphoneReason: We use the microphone for voice commands.

language.title: Language
language.restartBody: Switching between right-to-left and left-to-right needs the app to be closed and opened again so the layout can flip.

barcode.title: Packaged Item
barcode.cameraBody: Allow camera access to scan barcodes on packaged items.
barcode.lookupFailed: Could not look up this barcode. Please try again.
barcode.alignGuide: Line up the barcode inside the box
barcode.footnote: Packaging and Eco-Score data comes from Open Food Facts and is contributed by volunteers, so it can be incomplete or out of date.
